laws.rule: Kitulo National Park: Kitulo lies between Mbeya and Njombe. Do not pick flowers or collect plants, bulbs or seeds; stay on designated roads and footpaths. Walks follow marked trails or are accompanied by authorised guides/rangers. The shared-park entry is held here, not duplicated into every neighbouring region.

sources.title: Kitulo National Park: official visitor guide
sources.supports: Read directly: specific named-park access/guiding/booking and conservation requirements as stated, not all mainland parks or all regional laws.

local-law.note: Named park only. Current fees, temporary closures and wider regional/district law not yet checked. The guide is direct park-operator guidance, not a claim of reading every underlying statutory instrument.
